story.title: Add a spouse as a dependent
story.description: A benefits administrator submits an 834 maintenance type ADD for a spouse on an active subscriber. The enrollment system stores the dependent and keeps the subscriber coverage unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an active subscriber, when an ADD is submitted with relationship SPOUSE, then the spouse is stored as a dependent.
The subscriber coverage effective date does not change.

analysis.summary: Add a spouse with ADD. The spouse is stored, the subscriber date stays unchanged, and the outcome is ACCEPTED.

criteria.text: The spouse is stored as a dependent.
The subscriber coverage effective date does not change.

retrievedContext.title: enrollment business rules
retrievedContext.text: An ADD for relationship SPOUSE is accepted when the subscriber is active, and the subscriber coverage date stays unchanged.
